text.p: The following are top stories from selected Singapore newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Singapore Prime Minister Goh Chok Tong says changes to Constitution to increase number of MPs in each Group Representation Constituency will strengthen political system.
- Parliament passed amendments to Constitution which affect powers of elected president.
- Eleven-storey apartment building collapses in Cairo, killing five people, and 100 others feared dead.
- Fourteen stockbroking firms slash full-year profit forecasts for Singapore Airlines by average Singapore $128 million.
- Singapore Airlines share price tumbles to Singapore $13.00 for foreign tranche.
- Listed companies Faber Group and Tongkah Holdings and another Malaysian company win Malaysian $7.5 billion deal to provide hospital services.
- Hong Leong Group with Government of Singapore Investment Corp may be in group negotiating to buy JW Marriott Hotel in Hongkong for Hongkong $2.2 billion.
- Kian Ann Engineering launches initial public offer of 30 million new shares at Singapore $0.60.
- Philippine stock market takes a tumble of 3.73 percent.
- Wages and benefits of workers higher now in Singapore with hourly wage of S$10.32 compared to Taiwan and Hongkong.
